name: no-time
label: NO-TIME
title: No time to type
summary: Family and a new dog took the typing time: one hand on a leash, a phone in the other. Half the fix is Claude Code's /remote-control: the session runs on my machine, steered mostly by speech-to-text dictation. The other half is rigour without watching: the agent must behave the same way every time and follow BDD strictly (Gherkin, red, code, green, commit), so hooks enforce the order and log every run, and the record is read later instead of the agent being monitored. Controls that hold while nobody watches: what this talk asks of agents calling APIs too.
